title: SIGNL4
description: Send xyOps job and alert events to SIGNL4 for reliable mobile alerting, on-call routing and escalation.

params.title: Alert Title
params.description: Optional custom alert title. If empty, xyOps event/job data is used.

params.title: Alert Message
params.description: Optional custom message. If empty, xyOps event/job data is used.

secrets.title: SIGNL4 Team Secret
secrets.description: The team/integration secret from your SIGNL4 webhook URL.
